comment: The Terminology Service is presented as a foundational component, but the description sometimes conflates the runtime terminology service with the wider terminology-governance function. A service cannot itself determine national terminology policy.

public.text: The Terminology Service is presented as a foundational component, but the description sometimes conflates the runtime terminology service with the wider terminology-governance function. A service cannot itself determine national terminology policy.
public.suggestedRevision: Distinguish terminology governance, terminology content repositories, authoring and publication tools, and runtime terminology services. Explain that these may be implemented through one or several platforms.
